By KAREN VELIE The man who allegedly shot and killed his wife at their home in San Miguel on Monday night is an undocumented immigrant from Mexico, according to a detainer from the U.S. Department …

It’s estimated that 28% of people living in California are foreign born, according to the Public Policy Institute of California. The vast majority are living legally in California as documented immigrants or naturalized citizens. While making up only 6% of the population, undocumented immigrants were allegedly involved in 75% of murders in San Luis Obispo County in 2025 and 2026, according to information from law enforcement.
Responding to calls of shots fired on Monday night, San Luis Obispo County sheriff deputies arrived at the home of 66-year-old Jose Joaquin Sevilla Ruiz and 60-year-old Reyna Espinosa. While Sevilla Ruiz had fled before deputies arrived, his wife was found suffering from multiple gunshot wounds. Through their investigation, deputies learned the couple had quarreled before Sevilla Ruiz allegedly shot and killed his wife. He then fled SLO County, heading eastbound.
Deputies tracked down and arrested Sevilla Ruiz in Wasco. On Wednesday, the SLO County District Attorney’s Office charged Sevilla Ruiz with murder and an enhancement for use of a firearm. Also on Wednesday, Homeland Security asked the SLO Sheriff’s Office to inform them at least 48 hours before they release Sevilla Ruiz. He is currently being held without bail.
